summary: Validated FAQ persistence fix end-to-end for Site Menus Customer Support: Mongo singleton writes, GET reads, legacy migration, and admin UI save flow.
critical_code_review_comments: _get_site_menus now persists missing legacy faq_items/contact_form back to db.site_menus singleton via update_one($set), preventing read-time-only defaults.
PATCH /api/site-menus explicitly writes faq_items in payload order and keeps get_help/contact_form unchanged when omitted.
GET /api/site-menus returns persisted singleton faq_items and no hardcoded fallback override when faq_items already exists in MongoDB.
seed_data_creation: Temporary FAQ row created through admin UI for persistence verification, then restored to original singleton values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed pytest for /api/site-menus persistence + migration scenarios and Playwright admin UI save flow. Live singleton state was restored after tests.
rca of the issue: Original defect was a read-only fallback behavior: GET overlaid defaults when faq_items was missing but did not persist them. Verification confirms current implementation migrates missing faq_items/contact_form into MongoDB during _get_site_menus, and PATCH writes faq_items directly to singleton so edited/reordered/deleted FAQ rows persist and are returned by subsequent GET.
